welcome.title: Dragon Ridge
welcome.nameRequired: Enter your hero's name to start.

status.greeting: Welcome, {playerName}! You have {hp} health points. Let's begin your adventure!

start.text: {playerName} the {className} wanders through a dark forest. You have {hp}/{maxHp} health points. Suddenly a wolf blocks your path, and an old chest stands by the road.

end.text: Your adventure is over, {playerName}! You have {hp} of {maxHp} health points left. Inventory: {items}.
